meta.title: BloodLink — Cross-facility blood stock
meta.description: BloodLink unifies blood stock data across hospitals, blood banks, and donation units in real time.

hero.title: Blood stock you can trust, across facilities
hero.subtitle: Hospitals and blood banks often lose valuable time just confirming what stock actually exists. BloodLink unifies blood stock data across facilities in real time, so decisions are made from real numbers, not phone calls and guesswork.
hero.ctaPrimary: I want to become a donor

step1.title: Facilities record stock
step1.body: Every blood bag is recorded as soon as it's received, complete with status and expiry, directly from the facility holding it.

step2.title: Data syncs across facilities
step2.body: Stock status is visible to other authorized facilities, with no phone calls or waiting for manual reports.

step3.title: Requests are answered faster
step3.body: When stock is urgently needed, staff immediately know which facility has a matching, ready-to-use bag.

donor.title: For prospective donors
donor.body: Your blood donation matters more when its record is clear. This system helps facilities track every donated bag all the way to the patient who needs it.

points.p1: Your donation history is kept tidy at the facility where you donated
points.p2: Stock of your blood type is visible to facilities that need it at any time
points.p3: There's no account sign-up on this page — visit your nearest facility directly

facility.title: For hospitals & blood banks
facility.body: Manage your facility's blood bag stock and see availability at partner facilities, so urgent requests no longer depend on phone calls and guesswork.

points.p1: Every blood bag's status is tracked from intake to use or expiry
points.p2: Cross-facility requests are recorded and traceable
points.p3: Access is scoped per facility — only authorized data is visible

footer.tagline: BloodLink — cross-facility blood stock, one source of truth.
footer.note: Built for hospitals, blood banks, and blood donation units.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to access BloodLink according to your role.

shell.adminSummary: Verify facilities, manage donor administrative flags, and review the audit trail.

audit.heading: Audit Trail
audit.description: Read-only record of who changed what, and when. Rows are limited to what your account is allowed to see.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

reports.heading: Reports
reports.description: Wastage, crossmatch-to-transfusion ratio, and unit status flow over one shared period. Figures are shown as they are, without any assessment.
reports.windowLabel: Period {from} up to, but not including, {toExclusive} (UTC)

wastage.title: Wastage rate
wastage.chartLabel: Discarded and expired units (bars) and released units (line) per period

stockTrend.title: Unit status flow (not stock level)
stockTrend.note: This chart shows how many units moved into each status per period. It is not the number of units in stock right now. Current stock levels are kept in the hospital staff inventory dashboard.
stockTrend.chartLabel: Transitions into released, issued, discarded and expired per period, not stock level

selfCheck.heading: Check whether you can donate
selfCheck.subtitle: Answer a few quick questions. No sign-up, no visit to a facility.

basics.weightHint: Optional. If left empty, the result can't be confirmed.

awareness.legend: What the staff will ask you
awareness.note: These questions are for preparation only. Your answers aren't sent and don't affect the result.
awareness.i1: Are you currently ill, feverish, or taking medication?
awareness.i2: Have you recently had a tattoo, piercing, or surgery?

result.eligibleBody: Based on what you entered, nothing prevents you from donating.
result.notEligibleBody: A requirement isn't met yet. See the reasons below.
result.undeterminedTitle: The result can't be confirmed yet
result.undeterminedBody: There isn't enough data to answer. Fill in more details or ask the staff directly.
result.provisional: This is an early indication. The final decision is made by staff at screening.
result.failed: The check couldn't be run. Please try again shortly.

inventory.heading: Blood inventory
inventory.empty: No blood units match these filters.

urgent.heading: Create urgent request
urgent.description: Nearby stock is scanned in the same step, before any donor is called.

nearby.heading: Nearby stock
nearby.noRequesterLocation: The scan did not run: your facility has no coordinates yet. Ask an administrator to set its location. This does not mean there is no stock nearby.
nearby.noSourcedRule: The scan did not run: this component has no sourced compatibility rule yet. This does not mean there is no stock nearby.
nearby.noneInRadius: Scan complete: no compatible stock within the operational radius.
nearby.units: {count, plural, one {# compatible unit} other {# compatible units}}

facilities.heading: Facilities
facilities.description: Every facility registered in BloodLink. Verification means a facility may take part in the system; it is separate from whether the facility is currently operating.

filters.unverifiedHint: This only filters the rows already shown. The server has no verification filter, so other pages may still hold unverified facilities.

facilities.verifyHint: Verification is one-way: it cannot be undone from this panel.
facilities.emptyOnPage: Every facility on this page is already verified.

donors.heading: Donors
donors.description: Registered donors and their administrative flags. Administrative flags are time-limited, can always be lifted, and are separate from medical deferrals.

filters.searchHint: Matches similar names, not prefixes. Type the full name, then search.

flags.heading: Administrative flags
flags.empty: This donor has no administrative flags.

place.heading: Place an administrative flag
place.endsAtHint: Leave empty for no end date. The flag can still be lifted at any time.
place.rejected: This donor already has an active administrative flag. Lift it before placing another.

lift.rejected: This administrative flag has already been lifted.
